name: KIADB Aerospace Park
tagline: An employment district with several ways to live nearby.
description: The KIADB Aerospace and Hardware Park is an industrial and technology district in North Bengaluru. Boeing’s engineering campus and Shell Technology Centre are established employment landmarks in the wider park area. Residential developments have their own locations, phases and access arrangements; the park label does not mean every home is inside the same enclave.

faqs.question: How would Aaramv compare homes here?
faqs.answer: Our starting point is the workplace or destination you actually need to reach. We then separate the residential project from the industrial park and compare its registered block, road approach and home layout. For El Dorado and Jasper, we also make the parent–component relationship clear so the same township is not presented as two unrelated choices.
